Metadata.title: Power Fitness | Gym in Nasr City, Cairo
Metadata.description: Flexible memberships, expert coaches and a full weekly class schedule. Book classes online and check in with your QR code.

hero.subtitle: Flexible memberships, certified coaches and a full weekly class schedule. Book your spot from your phone, check in with your QR code and track every visit.
hero.imageAlt: A Power Fitness coach welcoming new members

plans.title: Memberships
plans.subtitle: Clear pricing with no hidden fees. Longer plans cost less per month, and every membership can be frozen while you travel.
plans.perkQr: Fast QR check-in at the door
plans.perkFreeze: Freeze your membership when you travel
plans.empty: New memberships are on their way. Visit the front desk for today's offers.

programs.title: Programs
programs.subtitle: From your very first workout to your next personal best, every program is led by a coach who specializes in it.

programs.empty: Our programs are being updated. Check back soon.

schedule.title: Class schedule
schedule.subtitle: Live availability for the coming days. Members reserve their spot online in seconds.
schedule.empty: Next week's schedule is being prepared. Check back soon.

coaches.title: Meet the coaches
coaches.subtitle: Experienced, certified and focused on you. Every class is planned and led by one of our team.

coaches.empty: Our coaching team will be introduced here soon.

how.title: Getting started takes minutes
how.step1Body: Sign up online in under a minute. All you need is your name, email and phone number.
how.step2Body: Choose a plan at the front desk and pay in person. Your membership starts the same day.
how.step3Body: Reserve classes from your phone and scan your personal QR code at the door. No cards, no queues.

contact.title: Visit us
contact.subtitle: Drop by for a tour of the gym, or get in touch and our team will answer your questions.

cta.title: Your first workout is one step away.
cta.body: Create your free account today, then activate your membership at the front desk whenever you're ready.

footer.tagline: A neighborhood gym for real progress: expert coaching, group classes and a community that keeps you coming back.
